WHEEL.Title: Player Wheel
WHEEL.Settings.AutoCloseControl.Name: Auto-Close Control Window
WHEEL.Settings.AutoCloseControl.Hint: Automatically closes the player selection window when you spin the wheel.
WHEEL.Control.Title: Player Selection
WHEEL.Control.Description: Add players and let the wheel spin for everyone!
WHEEL.Control.NoCandidates: No eligible players available (or all were already selected).
WHEEL.Willkommen.Einleitung: The player wheel decides visibly, for everyone at once, who goes next — instead of "erm, who hasn't had a turn?" a wheel spins and the whole table sees the same result.
WHEEL.Willkommen.Punkt1: Fair rotation — whoever has had a turn is marked done and stays out of the draw until everyone has been picked once.
WHEEL.Willkommen.Punkt2: Suspense, not a random number — the spin time varies and the wheel coasts to a halt. A roll behind the scenes does not feel like that.
WHEEL.Willkommen.Punkt3: Everyone watches — the spin runs over the socket on every screen, not just yours. The window can close itself once the winner is revealed.
WHEEL.Willkommen.Start: To begin: Shift+W opens the wheel, or the wheel icon in the token controls. Add the names, spin, done.
WHEEL.Willkommen.ForgeZeile: Every module, its documentation and the German translations in one place — open the module page
